title: Jupyter kernel rootfs identity proxy

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: A Jupyter benchmark is hermetic only if the kernel process and Python environment prove the same rootfs contract as Emacs.
hypothesis: A Python subprocess launched from inside Emacs should report cwd, executable, prefix, PATH, run id, and plan path; production mode must also have a Jupyter command in the rootfs closure.
minimal_fixture: A Python subprocess used as a kernel-side identity proxy; no real notebook kernel is launched by this batch-safe probe.
predicted_behavior: The proxy can record Python identity and stable run id, while production Jupyter benchmarks must additionally launch or attach a real kernel through the rootfs gateway.

independent_checks.name: Python identity proxy ran or production is not claimed
stable run id reaches Python when Python is available
Jupyter command is required only for production kernel benchmark evidence

counterexample: Checking only the Emacs process can miss a host Python kernel with the right printed result.
derived_gym_requirement: Jupyter actions must verify kernel-side rootfs manifest, Python executable/prefix, cwd, import path, run id, and bwrap plan before grading execution.
